hierarchy_rebuild.notes: FP32 -> FP16 packing + renderer init; measured directly in round-10

densify_sync.notes: Round-15: old gather+mask 15.4 ms -> new higs_gather_rows 5.6 ms (2.8x faster); round-17: fused zero-neg 8.36 -> 2.97 ms (2.8x)

prune_sync.notes: Drop pruned rows from Adam state

amortized_total.calculation: (3 rebuilds * 3.55 ms + 3 syncs * 5.6 ms) / 20 steps = (10.65 + 16.8) / 20 = 1.37 ms/step
amortized_total.notes: Based on higs_dynamic total ~44-46 ms on bicycle

optimizer_state_migration.notes: Scales with N; lower for train scene

amortized_total.notes: Dynamic overhead is smaller for LOW-N scenes

break_even_analysis.question: At what workload does hierarchical renderer savings exceed dynamic-topology maintenance cost?

additional_cost_vs_frozen.train: 19.03 (frozen) -> 17.07 (dynamic, with densify/prune) = actually FASTER due to densify/prune quality
additional_cost_vs_frozen.bicycle: 44.05 (frozen) -> 35.86 (dynamic) = actually FASTER due to N reduction
additional_cost_vs_frozen.notes: higs_dynamic is faster than higs_native because densify/prune improves quality and reduces N, not slower

paradox.observation: Dynamic topology does NOT erase the HiGS advantage; it amplifies it
paradox.explanation: Densify/prune reduces final N (train: 731K vs 1.03M; bicycle: 4.16M vs 6.13M), which reduces per-step cost beyond the fixed-state speedup
paradox.implication: H3 (topology overhead erases advantage) is REFUTED

cost_components: Optional: pack rebuild (deferred in round-18): ~3.2 ms (bicycle)
Forward + backward + optimizer: same as frozen

scaling_with_N.observation: Dynamic overhead scales sub-linearly with N
scaling_with_N.implication: Dynamic overhead is manageable even for high-N scenes

key_findings.H3_topology_overhead: REFUTED - Dynamic topology does NOT erase HiGS advantage; densify/prune quality gain amplifies it
key_findings.amortized_cost: 1.4 ms/step typical for HIGH-N, 0.3 ms/step for LOW-N
key_findings.deferred_pack_optimization: Round-18 deferred pack on training topology changes saves ~3.2 ms/event
key_findings.fused_gather_optimization: Round-15, 17 reduced optimizer-state sync by 2.8x (15.4 -> 5.6 ms -> 2.97 ms)
key_findings.overall: Dynamic topology overhead is small and well-optimized; HiGS advantage survives and amplifies
